title: Faucet Cover Frost 420D – Protects the Outdoor Faucet in Winter
descriptionHtml:
A burst water pipe is always discovered too late

The first real cold snap freezes the water in the outdoor faucet. The ice bursts the faucet or the pipe – and the damage only shows when everything thaws and leaks.

A winter jacket for the faucet

Pull the cover over the faucet and tighten it – the insulating lining keeps the frost away all winter. 420D Oxford fabric on the outside withstands snow, rain and ice.

Features

  • The faucet survives the cold snaps – thick insulating lining keeps the frost out
  • Stays on all winter – drawstring closes tightly around the pipe
  • Withstands weather for months – durable 420D Oxford fabric
  • Installs in ten seconds – slips over the faucet, no tools
  • Roomier than most faucet covers – 22 × 14 cm, reaches all the way to the wall

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
